relationships.subject: High-fat diet
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results revealed that consuming a diet rich in saturated fats for 8 weeks—prior to the development of obesity or diabetes—is sufficient to induce mechanical allodynia to a subthreshold dose of PGE2 in both males and females

relationships.subject: High-fat diet
relationships.evidence_quote: Cultured DRG sensory neurons from both HFD males and females had a significant increase in their response rate to capsaicin in comparison to their chow counterparts

relationships.subject: High-fat diet
relationships.evidence_quote: ATF3 is low to no expressing in chow tissue but is upregulated in HFD DRGs.

key_findings: 8 weeks of HFD without obesity or hyperglycemia sensitized mice to subthreshold PGE2 (diet-induced hyperalgesic priming) in both sexes
HFD increased capsaicin-responsive DRG neurons, ATF3 and plasma free fatty acids
